objective: Replace the fixed private EKS worker baseline with a cost-optimized, scale-to-zero Hoodi architecture while keeping the EKS API private and node egress constrained to required ports.
scope: Hoodi workload scheduling and egress contracts
acceptance: Dedicated m7i.4xlarge execution pool can scale 0..1
Dedicated m7i.2xlarge consensus pool can scale 0..1
platform pool can scale to zero when inactive
Hoodi node security group permits only DNS/private AWS plus TCP/UDP P2P and TCP 443 through existing NAT
existing control-plane and private endpoint protections remain
live EKS state and workload scheduling validate the new contract
